items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: J. C. Heard took my place, then Panama took J.C.'s.

ctx.x: I remember, Panama Francis took your place, right, eventually?
J. C. Heard took my place, then Panama took J.C.'s.
Because I've looked over Panama's oral history interview and he said that I guess as you said, Cab was very disciplined and he insisted on the band being punctual and sober ...
